title_sq: Tek Riverside Residence, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Planimetri Perfekte!!!
description_sq: Tek Riverside Residence, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Planimetri Perfekte!!! Prona ndodhet ne katin e 7 , te nje godine me 9 kate dhe eshte ne faze shtrimi. title_en: At Riverside Residence, 1+1 Apartment For Sale, With Perfect Layout!!!
description_en: At Riverside Residence, 1+1 Apartment For Sale, With Perfect Layout!!! The property is located on the 7th floor of a 9-story building and is under construction. The gross area is 87.87 m2, from which the net area is 71.65 m2. It is organized by a living room with a kitchenette, 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom and a balcony. The property also has a parking post with an extra price of 35,000 euros. The strategic location gives the residence the potential of one of the most developed and accessible areas in Tirana of the future. With an in-residence shopping mall, Riverside Residence offers a modern lifestyle interwoven with employment and full access to services for the entire urban space around it.
